The working title, The Social Media Radio Innovation and its Impact on University
Students' Ratings: An Exploratory Study, names the research problem operationally
rather than causally. Throughout this thesis the word impact is used in two sepa-
rately labelled senses:
 Empirical (exploratory association).

perceived broadcast quality (PB), broadcaster rigour (BR), star ratings,
